title: Option.unwrap
concept: Protect Option.unwrap() calls with requires: self.is_some() to ensure the caller has verified the value exists before extracting it.
why: Unwrapping a None value panics at runtime. A requires contract catches this at the call site with a meaningful error.
tips: Prefer match over unwrap — it handles both cases explicitly
If you MUST unwrap, add a requires: self.is_some() to move the check to the caller
Use Option.map() and Option.and_then() for safe chaining without unwrapping
common_mistakes: Unwrapping without checking first — the single most common XIOM crash
Using unwrap in library code that might be called by unknown callers
